subject: Emergency: curbside truck blocked + stage hail damage — urgent load-in fixes & speaker contingency
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Venue Ops <ops@lakeviewcenter.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-01-09T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Immediate help — curbside truck blocked and stage hail damage

Morning team,

We just hit two simultaneous issues on load-in for tomorrow's Summit session (Hall B, load-in dock B4):
- The third-party equipment truck (StageCraft) is stuck on 3rd Ave — a city parade routed traffic around the venue and the truck is blocked from the curb. They estimate ETA +90 minutes. Driver says they cannot access the staged lift without curb access.
- During the last 30 minutes there was a sudden hail squall; the temporary stage roof sustained punctures above the front-right truss and water got onto a powered amp rack. On-site AV (cc'd) is powering down the rack and drying but recommends a rapid tarp or patch to prevent further water ingress.

Immediate asks: 
1) Venue — can you open access to the secondary loading door on Jefferson (dock C2) and allow the truck to roll through to a sheltered spot? Contact person to meet the driver?
2) StageCraft (Jonathan) — can you confirm an emergency tarp + crew to patch the roof? Rough estimate and ETA so we can approve spend.
3) Marissa/Tessa — we need a decision on approving up to $1,500 for emergency covers + expedited crew and a backup plan if Dr. Shah's equipment is compromised (she's driving from the airport, ETA ~10:30).

Attaching site plan and photos uploaded by on-site AV. I will coordinate on the ground.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Head, Events — Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com
Mobile: +1 (206) 555-0187

From: Venue Ops <ops@lakeviewcenter.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: On-site AV Lead <john.parker@lakeviewcenter.com>
Date: 2027-01-09T08:29:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate help — curbside truck blocked and stage hail damage

Sergio,

Sorry to hear that — we had the parade on the street unexpectedly. John Parker (cc) can meet the driver at Jefferson secondary dock (C2). We will re-route traffic and have security hold the lane for 45 minutes.

As for the stage, we have a house crew with emergency tarps; they can be on-site in 20 minutes to install a temporary cover and run a quick inspection of the truss and amp rack. If there is water in power gear we strongly recommend those units remain off until dry-tested.

Please confirm if you want us to proceed with the tarp install and whether you will accept our crew's labor rate (we bill clients for emergency house crew at $125/hr plus materials).

— Lakeview Ops

From: StageCraft Rentals <jonathan@stagecraft.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-01-09T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate help — curbside truck blocked and stage hail damage

On Sat, 09 Jan 2027 at 08:29, Venue Ops <ops@lakeviewcenter.com> wrote:
> Sergio,
> 
> Sorry to hear that — we had the parade on the street unexpectedly. John Parker (cc) can meet the driver at Jefferson secondary dock (C2).

Sergio, Marissa — Jonathan from StageCraft here. Driver is 3 blocks away and will come to dock C2 once given access. We have an emergency tarp kit and two techs ready to install — ETA 35 minutes.

Prelim cost for tarp install + crew (emergency): $950 which includes materials and 3 hours of labor. If the roof patch requires structural shoring we'll add a follow-up line item (estimate on-site).

Also: generator delivery slip attached — the replacement diesel generator we requested earlier can make the curb delivery but will need a 2-person lift and a forklift to place it under shelter. If the dock C2 route is used, confirm forklift availability so we don't delay.

— Jonathan S., StageCraft Rentals
jonathan@stagecraft.com | +1 (415) 555-0156

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Venue Ops <ops@lakeviewcenter.com>, StageCraft Rentals <jonathan@stagecraft.com>
Date: 2027-01-09T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate help — curbside truck blocked and stage hail damage

Thanks for the quick updates. Approving emergency tarp install up to $1,200 (jonathan's quote $950 looks good). Please proceed with StageCraft and Lakeview house crew coordination — capture final receipt and send to me for reconciliation.

On the generator: yes, confirm forklift at dock C2. If forklift isn't available we will accept a delayed generator placement but prioritize protecting powered racks.

Dr. Amina Shah — we are monitoring her kit. If any of her equipment is water-damaged we will offer a loaner mic/amp and a telepresence fallback for her session. Dylan — please prep loaner kit and test wireless mics ASAP.

Marissa Cole
Senior Events Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
Mobile: +1 (425) 555-0120

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Venue Ops <ops@lakeviewcenter.com>, StageCraft Rentals <jonathan@stagecraft.com>, Dr. Amina Shah <amina.shah@ai-startup.com>
Date: 2027-01-09T11:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate help — curbside truck blocked and stage hail damage

Quick status update and plan (final):
- StageCraft driver has been routed to Jefferson dock C2 and is rolling in now. John (Venue Ops) met the truck. Generator placed under cover; delivery slip attached.
- Lakeview crew + StageCraft techs installed temporary tarps over punctured roof and removed residual water from the amp rack. AV tested power rails; all critical systems passed dry-test after 40 minutes.
- Dylan: please confirm loaner mic/amp prepped by 12:00. If any speaker kit fails we'll move Dr. Shah to the telepresence panel at 13:00.
- Finance: Ben — I'll forward receipts for the tarp (invoice attached) and any forklift charge; please expediate petty cash reconciliation.

Thanks to everyone for the rapid response. Lessons for the post-mortem: prebooked alternate dock access, vendor pre-approval for up to $2k emergency spend, and a small weather-resistant kit with spare covers on hand.

Attachments: site_plan_level2.pdf, tarp_install-quote.pdf, generator_delivery-slip.jpg

Sergio Alvarez
Head, Events — Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com
Mobile: +1 (206) 555-0187
